##### Project general facts

Khalid Bin Sultan City by BEEAH Group is a master-planned residential community designed by Zaha Hadid Architects, with fluid lines inspired by the iconic BEEAH Headquarters. Sleek, modern homes are set within lush green landscapes and supported by sustainable, net-zero-ready infrastructure. The community offers two-, three- and four-bedroom townhouses and four- and five-bedroom villas, each rising from a ground floor to an upper floor and designed for spacious family living.

A lifestyle avenue, a retail mall and a cultural centre form the social heart of the community, alongside wellness hubs, gyms and fitness studios. Community parks, swimming pools, children's play areas and jogging and cycling tracks create an active, family-friendly environment, while thoughtful urban planning keeps everyday needs within walking or cycling distance and encourages residents to connect with their neighbours and with nature.

Homes combine contemporary architecture with comfort and sustainability, featuring open, light-filled living spaces, generous windows and smart home systems that make everyday life simpler and more efficient. Private gardens and terraces extend the living space outdoors. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and appliances, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste and making each residence easy to personalise.

##### Location description and benefits

Sharjah is the cultural capital of the UAE, known for its museums, heritage districts, universities and family-oriented way of life. The community is set in the Al Sajaa area beside the BEEAH Headquarters, in a growing district of residential neighbourhoods, schools and services that offers a calm, spacious setting for families who value green surroundings.

Emirates Road, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Dhaid Road connect residents with Sharjah city centre, Dubai and the northern emirates. Sharjah International Airport and University City are a short drive away, Sharjah city centre and the Al Montazah Parks are within easy reach, and Dubai International Airport and Downtown Dubai are within comfortable driving distance.

Sharjah allows property ownership for international buyers in designated communities and offers some of the most accessible villa and townhouse prices in the UAE. A sustainable, architect-designed community with extensive shared facilities appeals to families seeking quality and value close to Dubai. A flexible payment plan and growing demand for family homes underpin rental demand and long-term value for owners.
